firstItem.reviewNote: Actual renderer readback is summer/clear/night. ASE, Ambasador and Europe House are close partial-facade crops from body-clear public source-road positions; they do not show complete landmarks. Window/facade detail and night-lighting accuracy remain estimates. Outward views show the coarse distant transition explicitly.

firstItem.label: ase · close partial facade in selected snow conditions

cameraBodyValidation.method: Production collideBuildings at actual public source-road centre and its exact native roadHeight, before capture; no offset toward or through the source facade

firstItem.reviewNote: Actual renderer readback is winter/snow/day. Close ASE/Ambasador/Europe House facade crops and leafless crowns are visible. These partial facades do not show complete landmarks; snow/fog, architectural detail and canopy appearance are not a matched winter reference. Outward views retain sparse generic context beneath the weather.

ground.notice: 4 matched walking-height viewpoints in each of four conditions, captured from the recorded production game source. Open any picture at its original size.
ground.setup: Production app, scene, actors, lighting and renderer at High quality, 1280 × 800. Automatic animation was paused and explicit frames rendered at fixed on-foot cameras 1.65 m above their supporting surfaces. Local simulation dates and weather were controlled; capturedAt records the real capture time.
limitations: Fixed on-foot appearance fixtures; cameras were positioned for inspection. These pictures do not establish a traversed route, activity completion, physical-phone behavior or hardware FPS.

The tree-lined junction viewpoint has seasonal canopy occlusion; it shows the sidewalk and frontage rather than an unobstructed junction overview. Existing road marking, night-light coverage and broader architectural fidelity issues remain open.
